official_source_url.value: https://www.gov.sm — "Carta dei Servizi" (Ufficio Stato Civile, Servizi Demografici ed Elettorali, Rev. 04/2026) official service charter, Sezione Passaporti, states: "La fotografia viene fatta in Ufficio al momento della richiesta (per i bambini da 0 a 5 anni occorre portare invece una fototessera)" — i.e. the photo is taken in-office at the time of application for standard applicants; only for children aged 0-5 must a 'fototessera' (standard ID photo) be brought instead, with no dimensions specified. Separately, the official gov.sm application form for residents-abroad ("modulo passaporto res all'estero") lists "1 fototessera" as a required attachment. Passport document validity is 10 years for applicants 14+ (3 years for ages 0-3, 5 years for ages 3-14) — this is the passport's own validity, not a stated photo-validity period.
